desc:
🟢 SLIME VS SLIME 🟠

Aim, launch and SMASH your slimes into your opponent in fast 1v1 battles!

⚔️ HOW TO PLAY
• Pick 3 slimes from your inventory
• Aim where your slime goes, then launch it into battle
• Each slime can only fight once per match, so choose wisely!
• Every round rolls a new environment like Fire, Ice or Ground. Slimes that match it deal DOUBLE damage
• Win 2 rounds to win the match

🥚 COLLECT
• Summon slimes from crates: Common all the way to Godly
• 1 in 50 chance for SILVER and 1 in 100 for GOLD, with boosted stats!
• Rare slimes and up have special abilities you press in battle

🔁 TRADE
• Trade slimes and gems with other players

⭐ PROGRESS
• Level up your slimes and earn XP
• Fill your Slime Journey for coins, gems and new slimes
• Complete quests and unlock titles to show off

Join our group for updates and codes!
